rationale: Round skipping: fold k=2 variables simultaneously at Phase 1→2 transition. Paper: Gruen 2024 Sec 5.
diagnostic: KILL CONDITION: Phase 2+3 is only 18% of Poseidon AIR sumcheck work (82% is Phase 1 with packed base-field at 65K+ pairs). Round skipping saves ~1.5% total prove time. Not worth protocol complexity (verifier changes + recursion circuit changes).

rationale: Split last full-round pair only: +16 cols (126 total), degree 10→9. Paper: Martins 2023.
diagnostic: Gate measured +0.87% slower (positive delta = regression). The 16 extra columns' Merkle overhead (~0.5% of 33% Merkle cost) exceeds the 10% AIR sumcheck eval reduction (~1.2% of 12% Poseidon AIR cost). The stacked PCS column budget is a hard wall: ANY column addition at this workload produces net regression because Merkle dominates. Noise floor 0.93% flagged unreliable.

rationale: Hybrid quotient: separate bus (2 constraints) from AIR (94 constraints). Apply quotient decomposition to AIR part only. Paper: Gruen 2024 Sec 4.
diagnostic: 148 saved constraint evals per pair = 444 operations = 1.4% total prove time. Below noise floor (0.93%). Not measurable. The constraint evaluation savings are dominated by the state computation chain (cube+MDS) which is shared across all evaluation points and cannot be reduced without degree reduction.
